source_evidence: These titles are not all the same and do not necessarily mean better service for you.
question: Misconception: An investment professional with more initials after their name is necessarily more qualified and will provide better service.
answer: Having initials after a name does not by itself show that the professional is more qualified or that you will receive better service. Titles differ, and some may limit which products the professional can sell, so ask what a credential means and whether it imposes any such limits.
